advice: Abstain. The supplied evidence does not establish a distinct, legal change to SME entry, exit, or ZA setup costs. The measured one-streaming-region panel32 variant already changes region structure and showed overlapping ten-run scores against paired controls; that joint outcome cannot identify a transition-cost effect. The active full512 kernel already uses one SME region for its full GEMM call. Do not infer that splitting or combining regions will help without a new, source-specific proposal grounded in evidence.
risks: Proposing another region-layout variant now risks repeating the measured one-region experiment or changing the approved kernel strategy without evidence. Any future proposal must preserve SME ABI boundaries, compute the full result within gemm, and time all setup, transitions, allocation, packing, and cleanup; no component speedup can be claimed separately.
